name: @bhojango/api-client
description: Typed API client generated from the backend's OpenAPI (core_api, realtime, worker)

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi/core.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/schema/core.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/realtime.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/schema/realtime.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/worker.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/schema/worker.ts
